brief.en: Turns peas into fireballs and does lanewide damage on defeat
brief.zh: 点燃经过的豌豆，死亡时对整行造成伤害

description.en: Torchwoods turn peas that pass through them into fireballs that deal twice as much damage. They also deal close damage as well as lanewide flame damage on defeat.
description.zh: 火炬树桩将经过的豌豆点燃，造成双倍伤害。他们也会对靠近的僵尸造成伤害，死亡时会在燃烧一整行的僵尸。

chat.en: Torchwood and Snapdragon have become fast friends. They like to hang out at either the Tiki Lounge or the Renaissance Faire.
chat.zh: 火炬树桩和火龙草形影不离。他们不是去提基酒馆，就是去学习复兴文化。

text.zh: 对靠近的僵尸造成伤害

text.en: does lane wide flame damage when destroyed
text.zh: 死亡时对整行僵尸造成燃烧伤害
